lesson.title: This Lob Is Yours
lesson.hook: This lob is shorter. You have time to turn and get under it. Calling your partner through would give away that comfortable overhead.

dloA.sit: Your pair has reorganised. Read this contact before trying to finish.
dloA.q: What does this next ball call for?
opts: Use controlled depth through the middle

lines.A: You give the ball room and prepare together for another reply.
lines.B: It lands here, but the smaller target leaves less margin. Keep covering.

dloA.take: Reachable overhead? Call it. Your partner covers.
dloA.payoff: Reachable overhead? Call it. Your partner covers.
dloA.principle: Reachable overhead? Call it. Your partner covers.
dloA.why: Lob depth and your balance decide ownership. A comfortable overhead need not trigger a switch. Place it with margin and prepare for another ball; an overhead is not a guaranteed finish.

lesson.pairPlan: Take a reachable overhead with an early “Mine.” The partner covers behind. If it carries beyond reach, call the switch early.
lesson.returnPrompt: Same partnership. Read what has changed.

comparison.summary: All four players stay involved. This is one illustrated continuation, not a predicted result.
comparison.intro: Same incoming ball. Compare how the first call changes the pair’s next job.

summaries.10: The pair’s first move fitted. The next contact still needed margin.
summaries.11: You read the pair’s coverage and gave the next ball room.
summaries.01: Your next shot had margin. Review the first coverage call together.

lesson.completionIntro: One call. Two responsibilities. Take the plan to your next match.

pro.label: From the coaching court
pro.moment: The LTA’s four-role framework keeps the non-hitter involved. When one player takes the overhead, the partner still has a coverage job.
pro.read: Lob depth and your balance decide ownership. A comfortable overhead need not trigger a switch. Place it with margin and prepare for another ball; an overhead is not a guaranteed finish.

drill.name: Rehearse as a pair
drill.how: Mix short and deep lobs without announcing them. Call ownership early. After a reachable overhead, insist on playing the next defensive reply.
